title: 第8章 冲突（1）

content_zh:
周志强两夫妻结婚两年后，才生下了周苗苗。一见二儿媳头胎生了个女儿，吴金凤的脸都黑了。在农村，丫头片子不顶事，没有儿子，人家会骂你绝户头。
谷大花两年后才生下儿子周家杰，吴金凤总算是有了笑脸。对这个来之不易的儿子，周志强两夫妻肯定比对女儿上心。有什么好东西自然都留给周家杰。
周苗苗看在眼里恨在心里。开始的时候，她还会从周家杰手里抢东西，被谷大花和周志强揍了几次后，周苗苗学精了。
靠着一张小甜嘴，周苗苗哄得奶奶吴金凤眉开眼笑，家里四个孙女，吴金凤对周苗苗最好。
见平日里最不受吴金凤待见的周园园都吃上了鸡蛋，周苗苗馋的满嘴的唾沫直往外冒，打定主意也要跑吴金凤那里讨个鸡蛋吃。周园园可以吃鸡蛋，她这个奶奶的小心肝，更不用说了。周苗苗想。
也难怪周苗苗这样认为。那个年代，家家户户的鸡就是个移动银行。好多人家里的油和盐，都是靠老母鸡下的蛋换回来的。
周家虽然不缺买油和买盐的钱，但是，家里的鸡和鸡蛋是属于周老太吴金凤的势力范围。在周家，只有吴金凤才有资格动家里的鸡蛋，其它人，就连周春平要吃个鸡蛋，也要和吴金凤报备一声。
周家的几个儿媳妇，如果没有吴金凤的允许，就连摸一摸家里的鸡蛋也是不许的。
吴金凤听周苗苗说周园园在吃鸡蛋，整个人都愣住了。
醒过神后，吴金凤急忙跑到自家的碗橱旁，拿出一盘鸡蛋数了起来。
九个？真的少了一个！
小心翼翼地放回装鸡蛋的盘子，吴金凤柳眉倒竖，气冲冲地走到三房住的西厢，大喝了一声：“赵芸香，你是不是偷了我的鸡蛋？”
西厢房里，赵芸香看着园园把一碗蒸鸡蛋吃了个精光，正笑吟吟地想夸女儿几句，猛不丁门口传来吴金凤的怒吼声。
吴金凤的大嗓门把周园园吓了一跳。经历过前世盛况的周园园忘了，这个年代一个鸡蛋五分钱，可以买二两盐，算是一笔不小的财富。
吴金凤的怒吼声让赵芸香吓得打了个哆嗦，看着床上那个小人儿露出担忧的神色，赵芸香摸了摸她软绵绵的头发，安抚了女儿一下。
随即，赵芸香站起身往门外走去，准备和吴金凤解释几句。
这件事是她不对，没有经过婆婆的同意，就拿了个鸡蛋煮给园园吃。
可是，一大早的，吴金凤没有起身，赵芸香也不好去吵婆婆睡觉。再说了，园园昨天被二房东苗苗推进池塘里，受了那么大的惊吓，就算拿个鸡蛋给孩子补补身体，也应该的吧?
“妈，我是拿了个鸡蛋煮给园园吃了。”赵芸香走到门口，坦然承认。
“你这个杀千刀的贼胚子！老娘下的蛋你也敢动？有娘生没娘教的东西！”吴金凤怒了。老周家谁不知道家里的鸡和鸡蛋都是她吴金凤的管辖范围？就连一家之主周春平都不敢做鸡蛋的主，老三家的问都不问一声就拿了，这不是明晃晃的打她的老脸吗？

听到吴金凤的叫骂声，赵芸香的脸‘刷’地一下全白了。贼胚子？有娘生没娘教？这样的污言秽语，吴金凤不仅仅是在骂她，而是连她的娘家一起骂了啊！
赵芸香十岁没了妈，和弟弟赵国辉跟着父亲一起生活。赵庆山怕娶个后娘对孩子们不好，一直没有再婚。
没娘的孩子本就可怜，到了吴金凤嘴里，还成了没教养的凭证？
在赵家沟，谁不夸赵庆山家的两个孩子教的好？赵芸香是十里八乡出了名的巧手裁缝，赵国辉年纪轻轻就当上了三合镇的供销社主任。
那时候的供销社，可不是后世的一间商场那么简单。那个年代，什么物资都是限量供应的，买布要布票，买自行车要自行车票，就算是买几两点灯用的煤油也要凭票。
赵国辉做为供销社的主任，手上的权利很大，有些不要票的紧俏物资，赵国辉可以做主，想卖给谁就卖给谁。
当然啦！赵国辉也不是个傻的，那些紧俏商品，当然先卖给三合镇上有头有脸的人物，剩下的才能自己做人情。
往日里，周家要买什么紧俏商品，都会让赵国辉帮忙。赵国辉看在姐姐赵芸香的面子上，对周家人基本是有求必应。
可惜周家人是不知道感恩的，赵国辉帮了周家不少忙，也没有改变赵芸香在周家的处境。

content_en:
Zhou Zhiqiang and his wife gave birth to Zhou Miaomiao two years after their marriage. Wu Jinfeng's face turned dark when he saw that his second daughter-in-law had given birth to a daughter for the first time. In rural areas, if a girl is not good enough and has no son, people will scold you for being destitute.
Gu Dahua gave birth to her son Zhou Jiajie two years later, and Wu Jinfeng finally had a smile on her face. For this hard-won son, Zhou Zhiqiang and his wife must be more concerned about their daughter. Whatever good things he has, he will naturally leave them to Zhou Jiajie.
Zhou Miaomiao saw it and hated it in her heart. At the beginning, she would snatch things from Zhou Jiajie's hands. After being beaten several times by Gu Dahua and Zhou Zhiqiang, Zhou Miaomiao learned the lesson.
With her sweet mouth, Zhou Miaomiao made her grandma Wu Jinfeng smile. Of the four granddaughters in the family, Wu Jinfeng was the best to Zhou Miaomiao.
Seeing that Zhou Yuanyuan, who was usually the least popular with Wu Jinfeng, had eaten eggs, Zhou Miaomiao was so greedy that saliva was pouring out of her mouth, and she made up her mind to go to Wu Jinfeng to beg for an egg. Zhou Yuanyuan can eat eggs, not to mention that she is a little sweetheart of a grandma. Zhou Miaomiao thought.
No wonder Zhou Miaomiao thinks so. In that era, the chicken in every household was a mobile bank. Many people get their oil and salt from eggs laid by old hens.
Although the Zhou family is not short of money to buy oil and salt, the chickens and eggs at home belong to Mrs. Zhou Wu Jinfeng's sphere of influence. In the Zhou family, only Wu Jinfeng had the right to touch the eggs at home. Others, even Zhou Chunping, had to report to Wu Jinfeng if they wanted to eat an egg.
Several daughters-in-law of the Zhou family were not even allowed to touch the eggs at home without Wu Jinfeng's permission.
Wu Jinfeng was stunned when she heard Zhou Miaomiao say that Zhou Yuanyuan was eating eggs.
After waking up, Wu Jinfeng hurried to his cupboard, took out a plate of eggs and started counting them.
nine? One is really missing!
After carefully putting the plate of eggs back, Wu Jinfeng raised her eyebrows and angrily walked to the west wing of the third bedroom and shouted: "Zhao Yunxiang, did you steal my eggs?"
In the west wing room, Zhao Yunxiang watched Yuanyuan finish a bowl of steamed eggs. She was smiling and wanted to praise her daughter when suddenly Wu Jinfeng's roar came from the door.
Wu Jinfeng's loud voice startled Zhou Yuanyuan. Zhou Yuanyuan, who had experienced the grand occasion in his previous life, had forgotten that in this era, an egg cost five cents, which could buy two taels of salt, which was considered a considerable fortune.
Wu Jinfeng's roar made Zhao Yunxiang tremble with fear. Seeing the worried look on the little man on the bed, Zhao Yunxiang touched her soft hair and comforted her daughter.
Immediately, Zhao Yunxiang stood up and walked out the door, ready to explain a few words to Wu Jinfeng.
It was her fault that she boiled an egg for Yuanyuan to eat without her mother-in-law's permission.
However, Wu Jinfeng didn't get up early in the morning, and Zhao Yunxiang couldn't disturb her mother-in-law. Besides, Yuanyuan was pushed into the pond yesterday by her second-hand landlord Miaomiao. She was so frightened that she should give the child an egg to replenish her health, right?
"Mom, I boiled an egg for Yuanyuan to eat." Zhao Yunxiang walked to the door and admitted frankly.
"You're a thief who can kill a thousand swords! How dare you touch the eggs I laid? You have nothing to do with me but my mother's teachings!" Wu Jinfeng was angry. Who in the old Zhou family doesn't know that the chickens and eggs at home are under her jurisdiction, Wu Jinfeng? Even the head of the family, Zhou Chunping, didn't dare to be the owner of the eggs. The third child took them without asking. Wasn't this a slap in the face?
Hearing Wu Jinfeng's yelling, Zhao Yunxiang's face suddenly turned white. A thief? Do you have a mother-in-law or a mother-in-law? Wu Jinfeng wasn't just scolding her with such dirty words, he was scolding her natal family as well!
Zhao Yunxiang lost her mother at the age of ten, and she and her younger brother Zhao Guohui lived with their father. Zhao Qingshan was afraid that marrying a stepmother would be bad for his children, so he never remarried.
A child without a mother is inherently pitiful.When it came to Wu Jinfeng's mouth, it turned into evidence that he was uneducated?
In Zhaojiagou, who wouldn't praise the two children of Zhao Qingshan's family for their good teaching? Zhao Yunxiang is a well-known skilled tailor from all over the country, and Zhao Guohui became the director of the supply and marketing cooperative in Sanhe Town at a young age.
The supply and marketing cooperative at that time was not as simple as a shopping mall in later generations. In that era, all supplies were in limited supply. Buying cloth required a cloth ticket, buying a bicycle required a bicycle ticket, and even buying a few taels of kerosene for lamps required a ticket.
As the director of the supply and marketing cooperative, Zhao Guohui has great power. Zhao Guohui can make the decision and sell it to whomever he wants for some in-demand materials that are free of charge.
Of course! Zhao Guohui is not stupid. Of course, those in-demand goods should be sold to the famous people in Sanhe Town first, and the rest can be used as favors himself.
In the past, when the Zhou family wanted to buy any in-demand goods, they would ask Zhao Guohui for help. Zhao Guohui basically responded to the Zhou family's requests for the sake of his sister Zhao Yunxiang.
It's a pity that the Zhou family is not grateful. Zhao Guohui helped the Zhou family a lot, but it did not change Zhao Yunxiang's situation in the Zhou family.
